descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Transport, logistică, lanț de aprovizionare și depozitare
Samskip is a truly international company that innovates the most advanced sustainable and multimodal international transport solutions. We are one of the largest transport companies in Europe. Within this structure, Samskip has shaped a comprehensive European network for short-sea, road, rail and inland waterway transport. This network provides pioneering sustainable, reliable and cost-effective options for the growing number of customers who demand more environmentally conscious logistics solutions.
 We are a product company. Our engineers build, own and continuously improve the software used by Samskip customers and employees. Teams have the freedom and responsibility to choose the technologies, tools and working methods that best fit the product, while maintaining high standards for security, scalability and maintainability.
 We are looking for a backend-oriented Full Stack Software Engineer who can contribute across the complete application stack and develop toward an AI Engineer role. You will design scalable services, APIs, integrations and user interfaces, while helping shape architecture, technology choices and engineering practices. 
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services, REST APIs and web applications. 
Build responsive frontend applications and integrate them with internal and external systems. 
Take end-to-end ownership from technical design and implementation to deployment and production support.
Contribute to architecture, technology selection, development methodology and continuous improvement. 
Use GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Claude or similar tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging and documentation. 
Critically review, test, secure and improve AI-generated code before using it in production. 
Identify, prototype and implement AI-powered product capabilities using LLMs and AI APIs. 
 Requirements: 
At least 5 years of professional backend development experience.
At least 2 years of professional frontend development experience.
Strong object-oriented development experience, ideally with C#, .NET and ASP.NET Core.
Professional experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
Experience designing REST APIs and integrating enterprise systems.
Good knowledge of relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server and/or Oracle SQL.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure; Microsoft Azure is preferred.
Understanding of secure development, JWT, OAuth and authentication.
Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and communicate effectively in English. 
 AI engineering capabilities: 
Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted development using Claude, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot or equivalent tools.
Ability to integrate AI services and APIs into products and turn prototypes into maintainable production solutions.
Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management and model limitations.
Experience with Azure OpenAI/OpenAI APIs, Claude APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, AI agents or AI evaluation is an advantage. 
Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, security, licensing and quality risks. 
 Why join us 
 • Product ownership: build and evolve our own products instead of moving between external customer projects. 
 • Technical autonomy: influence architecture and choose technologies, frameworks and tools based on product needs. 
 • Freedom in ways of working: help shape the methodology and engineering practices used by the team. 
 • Visible impact : work directly with the business and users of the products you build. 
 • AI growth: develop from an experienced Full Stack Engineer into an AI-enabled Software Engineer / AI Engineer.
 What we offer 
Competitive salary.
13th month bonus.
Holiday allowance.
Travel allowances.
Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
The chance to be part of a dynamic and innovative company shaping the future of logistics.
